data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1 (Step 4 plan review feedback): Add symmetric-case test test_diff_emits_outbound_create_for_new_local_ticket: Given local_state with ticket C having no dso_local_id + jira_state empty; When diff called; Then result contains exactly one (outbound, create) targeting C (confirms exclusion logic does not suppress all creates). Standardize N=100 invocations for purity test (matches Task 2 hash-stability N). Add return-type annotation requirement: differ.diff function signature carries '-> list[Mutation]'. Add caller inventory AC: 'grep -r "from.*differ import\|import.*differ" plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/ tests/ -l > /tmp/differ-callers.txt; if any non-test caller exists, preserve old signature as deprecated shim OR update all callers atomically'.
